$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：天機天梁坐辰戌，《深造講義》p.215。

basis.quote: 须祥其为尖刻，抑为明断

rules.text: 你的天機化忌，動盪不安，容易反應過度而變得尖刻。
rules.en: Your Tian Ji is transformed by Ji: restless and unsettled, prone to overreacting and turning sharp.

rules.text: 會照的太陰化忌，令你容易反應過度而變得尖刻。
rules.en: Tai Yin transformed by Ji in your trine makes you prone to overreacting and turning sharp.

rules.text: 會照的天同化忌，令你容易反應過度而變得尖刻。
rules.en: Tian Tong transformed by Ji in your trine makes you prone to overreacting and turning sharp.

rules.text: 會照的太陽或巨門化忌，加強天梁的孤剋，容易流於尖刻。
rules.en: Tai Yang or Ju Men transformed by Ji in your trine strengthens Tian Liang's isolating edge, which can turn sharp.

source.quote: 则加强天梁的孤克本质

rules.text: 你的天機吉化，敏感靈動得以發揮，與天梁配合成為明斷。
rules.en: Your Tian Ji has a favourable transformation, so its quick sensitivity comes through and, with Tian Liang, becomes clear judgement.

source.quote: 则天机的敏感灵动得以发挥

rules.text: 有輔佐吉星會合，機梁的性質得以調和。
rules.en: Supporting stars meeting your chart bring Tian Ji and Tian Liang into balance.

rules.text: 煞星並湊，機梁的性質互相衝突，容易變得尖刻。
rules.en: Malefics gather in your chart, setting Tian Ji and Tian Liang against each other, which can turn sharp.
